verdict.rationale: The pack never documents a per-role interview plan: no defined stages, no reusable question banks, and no per-interviewer focus areas attached to a role. The only related item is an AI interview-question generator (lever-docs-27), which is an adjacent one-off question-generation tool rather than a structured plan defined once and reused per role. Automation Hub stage advancement and custom configurations are separate features and earn no credit here.

support.subject: As a recruiter, each role carries an interview plan — stages, question banks, and per-interviewer focus areas defined once and reused
